apps.name: TubeLocalBread
apps.subtitle: Ad-free YouTube player with downloads
apps.localizedDescription: Personal ad-free YouTube client: Piped/Invidious streams, background audio, downloads, smart downloads and casting.

versions.localizedDescription:
- CLAUDE.md: leftover standalone SideStore row in LC+SS and how it was removed
- Diagnostics: purge local logs older than 7 days (audit files, MetricKit payloads, patch log trim)
- Captions in fullscreen: show the native subtitle track for the CC language, restore CC and caption size after exit
- Rotate to landscape when a landscape web video goes fullscreen, back to portrait on exit
- Audit log: caption probe (timedtext requests + caption DOM/track state on CC taps)

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Find Chromecast devices to cast to, and connect to your self-hosted Piped/Invidious server or diagnostics collector on your network.
